known_issues: Design decision, accepted by the Main Agent: the channel list is the OBSERVED projection, so a channel that stops carrying frames disappears from it while its binding remains — the binding is then neither visible nor removable until the next project switch clears it. The worker deliberately did not fold the binding key set into the list, because that would make the binding map itself a channel source. Recorded as a known limitation; deferred.

The Bind gate is stricter than the contract's minimum: it also requires an open project and a writable session, because WorkspaceSessionStore.bindChannel throws without a project and cannot verify asset ownership.
